identity_check: Confirmed as Galvant (galvant.ai), formerly Takt: Pear VC's portfolio page lists 'Galvant - AI workforce for your manufacturing back offices' and links to galvant.ai, whose site banner reads 'Takt is now Galvant'. A Pear-posted job ad for Takt names the same founders (Adhitya Raghavan CEO, Will Zunker CTO) and PearX membership. galvant.ai is a client-side app, so its text was read from the JS bundle the site serves (assets/index-DjVFJB00.js); page URLs below are the routes where that text renders. Ruled out (seen in search results): Galvanick (LA industrial cybersecurity), GALVANY (Berlin heat pumps), Galventa (Swiss pharma services), Galvant Industries (Waterloo hobby electronics, old X profile), Galva.AI (electroplating), Galvia AI (Ireland), Galvan (Utah health). Pear VC also backs SalesPatriot, Parallax Worlds, Covalent and Meridian, which is consistent with the founder's list. Category set to 'direct' (PROJECT_CONTEXT seed said 'adjacent (verify)'): Galvant sells agents for manufacturers' RFQ quoting, procurement (vendor POs, change orders, packing-slip/invoice matching), AR/AP and plant-data reporting, which is the same procurement and RFQ wedge as ours. Differences: it targets back-office staff at small and mid-size US manufacturers through ERP/email, not shop-floor staff over WhatsApp, and it does not cover maintenance or process stability.

company.name: Galvant
company.description: US start-up (formerly Takt) building AI agents that run quoting, procurement, AR/AP and reporting for small and mid-size manufacturers.

layer_detail: Manufacturing back-office agents on a shared data layer ('Galvant intelligence layer' over ERP, CRM, historian, bank feeds, email and spreadsheets). Named agents: Val (reads RFQs, pulls pricing, checks margin, drafts quotes), Kit (turns vendor emails into master POs, tracks change orders, matches packing slips to invoices), Billy (cash application, AR/AP reconciliation, claims) and Scout (analytics across ERP/historian data). A person approves every step. Claims go-live in days; dedicated Azure instance per customer. Channel is ERP/email/web, no WhatsApp seen.
product_summary: Agentic platform for manufacturers that unifies ERP, email, spreadsheet and plant data, then runs supervised workflow agents for RFQ quoting, vendor PO and invoice matching, AR/AP cash application and on-demand reporting, with human approval of each step and deployment in days rather than months.
